summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ), a Cayman SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a second amendment to its June 17, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with EigenQ, Inc., a Delaware software target. The September 17, 2026 amendment clarifies which Company stockholders are bound by the Registration Rights and Lock-up Agreement via newly added Annex B, and extends the Outside Date from February 14, 2027 to June 30, 2027, with automatic monthly extensions upon written consent of SVAQ and the Company. The deal involves Cayman-to-Delaware domestication and a merger sub reverse merger. Watch extension votes, redemptions, and closing conditions.
